# Price the route, not just the miles.

> Free medical courier route calculator: margin per stop and vehicle-hour after paid wait, deadhead and overhead — plus the per-stop rate to quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
